hook_line: TOP SIX IT FIRMS SHED 24,422 ROLES IN A YEAR

hook_stat.sub: Engineering roles shed by India's top six IT firms in one year

stats.label: Attrition rate, in the normal range

diaspora_bullets: Replacement hiring slowed for maintenance and support roles
AI, cloud and cybersecurity demand keeps growing
news_summary: Combined IT and engineering headcount at TCS, Infosys, HCLTech, Wipro, Tech Mahindra and LTIMindtree fell 24,422 in a year, from 822,144 in October 2025 to 797,722 in October 2026.
payoff: Firms left vacant seats unfilled — this is not a layoff count.
